name: codebook-md
displayName: Codebook MD - Organize Notebooks & Execute Code-Blocks
description: Organize and execute your notebooks and markdown (.md) documentation files locally! Supports Go, JavaScript, TypeScript, Bash, Python, SQL, HTTP. Auto-integrates with VS Code markdown extensions for enhanced rendering.

codebook-md.rootPath.description: The root path of the workspace. This is used to resolve relative paths in code blocks.

codebook-md.notebookConfigPath.description: Directory path where notebook configuration files will be stored. Configuration files are named with the notebook filename + '.config.json'. If not set, defaults to the same value as execPath.

codebook-md.execPath.description: Path where temporary exec-related file(s) will be stored.

codebook-md.permalinkPrefix.description: Prefix for identifying permalinks. When matched in a markdown, the permalink will be converted to a link to the same file/lines in VS Code.

codebook-md.frontMatter.showInNotebook.description: Show YAML Front Matter as the first cell in notebooks

codebook-md.go.execType.description: Execution type for Go code: 'run' uses execTypeRunConfig, 'test' uses execTypeTestConfig.

filename.description: Filename to use for 'run' execution type.
Filename to use for 'test' execution type.

buildTag.description: Build tag to use for 'test' execution type. This tag is added to the top of the test file to help ensure it doesn't run in normal test runs.

codebook-md.go.goimportsCmd.description: 'goimports' requires goimports to be installed. If null, 'gopls imports' will be used.

codebook-md.go.excludeOutputPrefixes.description: Output lines starting with any of these prefixes are hidden from Go cell output.

codebook-md.go.output.showExecutableCode.description: go: Show the executable code at the top of the output. Overrides codebook-md.output.showExecutableCodeInOutput.

codebook-md.go.output.replaceOutputCell.description: go: Replace the output cell on each run. When false, output is appended. Overrides codebook-md.output.replaceOutputCell.

codebook-md.go.output.showTimestamp.description: go: Show the timestamp at the top of the output. Overrides codebook-md.output.showTimestamp.

codebook-md.go.output.timestampTimezone.description: go: Timezone to use for the timestamp (e.g. 'UTC', 'America/New_York'). Overrides codebook-md.output.timestampTimezone.
